name: Certificates
description: One row per product certificate: its type (CE, FCC, RoHS, UN38.3, UKCA, and for toys EN 71, ASTM F963, CPSIA / CPC), issuer, certificate number, issued and expiry dates, the file, and where the facts came from. A product page shows the type and "valid until" of each certificate that has not expired, never its number; an expired one, or type Other, is not shown. The daily shop check warns before one expires.

agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-shop` skill in this folder, then list the certificates that are expired or expire within the warning days in the shop's Settings, soonest first, with the product each belongs to and whether the product page still shows it.

label.en: Record a new or renewed certificate
label.zh-CN: 登记新证书或续期证书

agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-shop` skill in this folder and follow "Certificates (证书)": record the certificate I describe (type, issuer, number, issued and expiry dates, file, and a source note naming the document and page) for the product I name. Never invent an expiry date or an issuer: leave it empty and tell me what is missing.
